title: Thundercat's Distracted
description: Thundercat returns six years after his last album with Distracted, produced mostly by Greg Kurstin, with Tame Impala, A$AP Rocky, Lil Yachty and an unreleased 2018 recording of Mac Miller.
author: Nir Hasson
intro: Gifts for Passover and for days of war. One new album I loved this week, and it's a big one.

albums.label: Brainfeeder
text: Thundercat is back with a new album, Distracted, released exactly six years after his last one. Unlike his previous albums, which were produced by Flying Lotus, this time most of the album was put in the hands of Greg Kurstin, a producer who has worked with Adele among many others.

The album is full of collaborations: Tame Impala on "No More Lies", A$AP Rocky on "Funny Friends", Lil Yachty and Flying Lotus on "I Did This To Myself", The Lemon Twigs and Channel Tres. Most moving of all is the late Mac Miller, who appears on "She Knows Too Much" through an unreleased recording from 2018. Fifteen tracks, released on Brainfeeder.
